%doc: Source-of-truth manifest for the `dependencies` Bucket table: one row per module or template page, written by Module:Dependencies while the page renders itself, naming the wiki modules it requires, loads and invokes and the stylesheets it loads. A page reads the rows that name it, or its /styles.css, to list its dependents. The names say `modules`, `functions` and `Stylesheets` because every registered manifest shares one flat property namespace. type/bucket/field/index/repeated are the Bucket keys; desc is documentation only.

Required modules.desc: Wiki modules the page require()s, as Module:Name. Literal names only.

Loaded modules.desc: Modules the page reads with mw.loadData or mw.loadJsonData.

Invoked functions.desc: Module:Name|function for each {{#invoke}}, so the invoked module can name the function.

Stylesheets.desc: TemplateStyles pages the page loads, as full titles (Module:Icon/styles.css).
